listed_quote.quote: has closed, creating a publicly registered non-traded business development company. With the closing of the merger, TPIC has been renamed TP Flexible Income Fund

announcement.quote: If that proposal, or any other TPIC or PWAY proposal is not approved, the Merger will not be completed.

outcome_evidence.quote: the merger between Triton Pacific Investment Corporation, Inc. (“TPIC”) and Pathway Capital Opportunity Fund, Inc. (“PWAY”) has closed

deals.notes: The merger was completed on or about 2019-04-01 (TPIC renamed TP Flexible Income Fund, later Prospect Flexible Income Fund); shareholders of both approved on 2019-03-15. Both_listed is false because the surviving TPIC/FLEX is described as a non-traded BDC; no excerpt shows exchange listing for PWAY. Acquirer/target roles come from the 425 headers (filed by TPIC, subject company PWAY) and the renaming of TPIC. The N-14 8C of 2018-08-13 (seq 2) is the earliest registration filing of the Merger but its excerpts do not name PWAY, so the quote is taken from the later amendment.

problems: Outcome label follows the rule that both_listed false gives not_a_listed_pair, although the text states the merger closed.
